basic_profile.bio: Avid drummer and cryptocurrency enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a software engineer at a tech startup and by night, I jam with my band or dive into the latest crypto trends. I'm a big fan of the keto lifestyle and enjoy experimenting with new recipes. I tend to be online during late evenings, around 9 PM to 1 AM CST. Currently single, I spend most of my free time either practicing music or trading cryptocurrencies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been playing the drums since high school. I picked up cryptocurrency trading a few years ago through online courses and forums. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-teaching, particularly in tech and financial markets.
